cases.restriction: A20 p.95 specifies 2 K for its corresponding 1D calculations; not an experimental 0.9 K measurement.
Do not equate these measurements and biases with K20's 0.9 K figures.
Illustrative numerical initial condition, not optical waist or uniquely measured material.
Qualitative/fit comparisons, not a universal 1D validity claim or permission to count initial phonon escape twice.

interpretation_risks.detail: 2018 and 2020 best jitter figures and acquisition details differ.
340 ohm/square room-temperature initial film, 608 ohm/square hotbelt fit and 600/650 ohm/square thesis model variants have different provenance.
K20 PDF13 uses 33 uA vs depairing estimate38.8 uA; family caption PDF24 reaches35 uA. Exact device/condition association unresolved.
Wafer reflections and taper events must not be inferred to be intrinsic condensate delay statistics.
Polarization/transverse absorption remain relevant even for some narrow-wire cases; no width-only 1D threshold established.
Initial retained photon energy, subsequent phonon escape and external/resolved inductance require separate ledgers.

missing_for_reproduction: Raw event-time data, fitted IRF covariance and digitization/trigger settings for the selected point
Exact specimen and bias assignment for each record value
Calibrated readout transfer function, input impedance and noise spectrum
Full taper/contact geometry and optical absorption profile
Independent uncertainty/covariance for inferred material parameters
Source-approved finite-domain and transverse-homogeneity criteria over the required transient window
